conventions.error: forecast / measured - 1 (positive: the model forecasts more); rms, bias and worst over cases
conventions.head_to_head: d = |ln(measured / second)| - |ln(measured / first)|; first closer where d > tie, second where d < -tie; exact two-sided sign test on the untied, alpha 0.05, at least 6 untied
conventions.bands_form: measured / forecast - 1 (E211's T1-T3, E1-E4), for the 'inside MM1-v1's bands' counts
conventions.F1_given: F1's frozen W (no seconds term) at the measured seconds
conventions.F2_given: NOT AVAILABLE: E211 froze no F2 function of the seconds (its scorer computes none) and this lane runs no route
conventions.F1_NC_cycles: F1 and NC carry one cycles figure an op, read against the wall and against the counter's mean
conventions.family_C_columns: at c01c and c02c the v2 and v1 columns are their C1 columns (E211's registered rule C1, E101's measured one-block figures carried on each model's twin); their literal columns (C0) beside

R0_own_reading.note: this lane's own reading of E211's R0 conditions on the reduced data (checks, gates, walks; not the smoke's band); the registered verdict is the card lane's scorer's

controls.note: every model forecasts 1 at the controls (the two walks are one op stream); a measured offset there is the two compiled loops' code-path difference (E211.md section 6, Amendment A1)

timing_simulation_REPORTED.note: MM1-v2's step column is rgm136's cooperative gemmL step law at every point (as MM1-v1's); simulator steps, not time; at gemmLn and gemmLnc points not the count of the point's own ELF and walk

desk_v2_vs_v1_forecasts.what: ln(MM1-v2's forecast / MM1-v1's), from the frozen files alone (desk, before any datum): the room the head to head has
